dataset_name: ColdGuard-AI Physics-Informed Synthetic Cold Storage Dataset
disclaimer: NOTICE: All data in this dataset is SYNTHETIC and generated via a calibrated lumped-capacitance thermodynamic ODE model. It is intended for algorithm development, excursion forecasting benchmarks, and digital twin visualization.

target_variables.temp_forecast_15m: Continuous ground-truth temperature in °C at t + 15 minutes
target_variables.temp_forecast_30m: Continuous ground-truth temperature in °C at t + 30 minutes
target_variables.temp_forecast_60m: Continuous ground-truth temperature in °C at t + 60 minutes
target_variables.excursion_risk_30m: Binary flag (1 = safety limits breached within [t+1, t+30], 0 = safe)
target_variables.excursion_severity_30m: Multiclass (0 = Safe, 1 = Warning proximity, 2 = Critical Breach)

feature_variables.temperature: Sensor observed air temperature in °C (includes noise and anomaly corruptions)
feature_variables.door_activity: Door status mode: closed, open_routine, open_extended
feature_variables.compressor_status: Refrigeration state: running, idle, failed, degraded
feature_variables.power_consumption_kw: Total instantaneous electrical power draw in kW
feature_variables.sensor_health: Sensor health status: healthy, degraded_drift, stuck_frozen, spike_anomaly, missing

zone-a.name: Vaccine Storage A
zone-a.calibration_standard: ASHRAE 10-2022 / FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Cold Chain Standards

zone-b.name: Dairy & Produce Chiller B
zone-b.calibration_standard: ASHRAE 10-2022 / FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Cold Chain Standards

zone-c.name: Deep Freeze Vault C
zone-c.calibration_standard: ASHRAE 10-2022 / FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Cold Chain Standards
